notes: IMDStrategyToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with no constructor arguments. Its constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 IMDSTR with 18 decimals to msg.sender, which is the factory at launch. There are no application contracts, transfer fees, or administrative minting, burning, pausing, or blacklisting functions. pool.initialPrice records provenance; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the total supply.
